assumptions: The caller guarantees the scores array holds an entry for every index the scan reaches; the native code reads scores[i] without a length check, so running past the end is a model guard error, not a native behavior.
Nothing in this function mutates the object, so the gate bound recomputed each iteration is constant for a fixed object.
The native function reads only rsi; rdi is never read before the gate call, where rdi is set to the object.

0x5dbd788.rule: score >= 1.0 (rodata 0x4592b0) -> return 1; NaN does not take the branch

0x5dbd794.rule: gate bound >= index (signed 32-bit) -> next score; else return 0

0x5f6b72d.rule: flag byte at obj+0xa90 nonzero -> gate returns 0
